milestones.title: Witness a live direct child blocked in a capacity-scaled write and released by overflow kill
milestones.deliverable: Add TestBlockedChildOverflowKill using an archived fake interpreter that execs a helper mode of the Go test binary. The child records PID before one blocking stdout write of at least four times the freshly measured pipe capacity, and records wrote-all or short-write only if the syscall returns. Require OutputLimitError without TimeoutError, no completion marker, dead child, and each captured stream at most the 64-byte cap. ExecTimeout is 120 s; a 30 s watchdog fails and cleans up, never passes as an oracle. Existing 513-byte real-interpreter test remains a wiring control; a second real-interpreter arm is feasible in principle but not worth the added language and marker dependencies here.

mutations.mutation: M-kill-off: make overflow killOnce body or killGroup a no-op; the blocked child can otherwise wait for the 120 s F5 deadline
mutations.must_fail_test: TestBlockedChildOverflowKill: 30 s watchdog fires and independently kills/reaps the child; test fails unconditionally

mutations.mutation: M-drain-all: make readCapped drain to EOF rather than limit+1
mutations.must_fail_test: TestBlockedChildOverflowKill: child writes all bytes and its wrote-all marker appears; test fails

mutation_revert: Run each mutation alone, save pre-edit SHA-256 with shasum -a 256, restore original bytes by file copy, and require byte-identical SHA-256 before the next mutation. M-kill-direct-only is not a relevant killer of this direct-child test; TestOverflowKillReachesForkedGrandchild owns that group-kill property.
